Usage
Use checkboxes if more than one option can be selected. If user input is required on a checkbox, place the
Use checkboxes if more than one option can be selected. If user input is required on a checkbox, place the FormControl/isRequired component next to the label with 4px distance with absolute position selected (icon in the top right of frame settings). This workaround is necessary to ensure resizing of the checkbox works as expected. CheckboxGroup is available as a template.
Use the Show form control elements toggle to add HelpText or a ValidationMessage.
Use when the action is well understood by a standard icon or when space is limited
